description: Pre-registered CPU-cache acceptance. Existing physical/alias/solver gates remain unchanged; these check that cached scheduling has the same continuation as recomputing from the physical state, and that the nonlinear Newton cache still solves the declared nodal equations.

oscillator.fixture: 88200, 96000, 192000 and 384000 Hz internal; nominal and 1 ms coupling RC; compare 8192 samples with an otherwise identical oscillator restored from its complete physical/residual state each sample. Include stopped/running steps, frequency changes, pulse threshold changes, waveform gates, idle advance and full/idle-state restoration. The uncached schedule is a continuation oracle, not independent hardware evidence. Existing independent event timing, pin anchors and complex-spectrum gates still apply. Efficiency fixture: 96000 Hz internal, 261.6 Hz, nominal RC, 8192 steady samples after warm-up.
